open_points.subject: Model M08 — Refusal / A6 rule 1
open_points.text: A delivery is M08 for the refusals of A3 rule 4 and A6 rules 1 and 5, and M06 for the failures of A3 rule 5.
open_points.question: What product action and refusal condition does “A6 rule 1” denote, so an implementer can determine when that action creates an M08?
options: A6 rule 1 is the record-publication refusal when the photo was not placed.
A6 rule 1 is the record-publication refusal when a different Portal photo id was already recorded for the source.
A6 rule 1 denotes some other refusal condition or product action not defined in the supplied texts.
open_points.default_guess: Treat A6 rule 1 as the record-publication refusal for a photo that was not placed, because the added M08 coverage most plausibly corresponds to the `not_placed` refusal already present in RefusalCode.

witness.initial: A source has no placement and therefore no publication mark.
events: The calling flow asks the deliverer to record a Portal photo id for that source.
outcomes: An implementer reads A6 rule 1 as the not-placed case and returns M08 without changing state.
An implementer reads A6 rule 1 as a different, undefined case and cannot establish from State 1 that this request creates M08.
witness.observer: The calling flow and owner see whether the operation has a defined M08 result.
